title: Proof of Dhar's Minimal Sand Conjecture for the Manna Sandpile
description: LaTeX source, figures and verification programs for the paper Proof of Dhar's Minimal Sand Conjecture for the Manna Sandpile. Every recurrent configuration of Manna's stochastic sandpile on an l x m rectangle has at least ceil((l-1)(m-1)/2) grains, as Dhar conjectured in 1999; in d dimensions the bound ceil(prod(l_i-1)/2^(d-1)) is exact when at least d-1 sides are odd.
